intro.h2: One call for the whole bathroom
paragraphs: CK Tile and Home Repair LLC is a locally owned crew doing bathroom remodeling in Minneapolis, led by Ciro. Tile is the heart of the business, from full bathrooms to kitchen backsplashes, but Ciro also coordinates the rest of the job so you are not juggling separate trades.

One homeowner had Ciro arrange the tile pickup and the plumber, resurface the ceiling, level the floor and then install the tile. Another, an engineer with picky taste, watched tile setter Francisco center everything around a large glass block window in her shower. Google tags nine reviews for bathroom remodels and five for finishing ahead of schedule.

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Complete bathroom remodels, including plumbing, wall finishes, fixtures, vanities and tile. One customer had two bathrooms remodeled in a single winter and called the work responsive, prompt, trustworthy and high quality at a fair price.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with marble-look hexagon floor tile, wood vanity with white top and a round brass-framed mirror

items.name: Tile showers and tub surrounds
items.blurb: Walk-in showers and tub surrounds in glazed vertical tile, square tile and stacked layouts, with niches, corner shelves and mosaic floors. Layouts are planned around windows and fixtures so every line sits where it should.

image.alt: Blue-gray square tile tub surround centered on a glass block window with two corner shelves

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Bathroom and entry floors in marble-look hexagons, octagon and dot patterns or bold patterned tile. Ciro levels the subfloor first when needed, as he did for one homeowner before installing her new tile, so the finished floor sits flat.

image.alt: Black and white patterned floor tile running through a small room and doorway

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: CK Tile installs kitchen backsplashes as well as bathrooms, as the business notes on Facebook. Call Ciro with photos of your kitchen and the tile you like, and he can talk through layout, outlets and trim.

about.h2: About Ciro and the CK Tile team
about.text: CK Tile and Home Repair LLC is a locally owned company based on 57th Avenue North in Minneapolis, with its Facebook page listed in Crystal. Ciro runs the business and works with a small team that includes tile setter Francisco. Customers describe Ciro as friendly, patient with questions and quick to respond. The company focuses on tile, from full bathrooms to kitchen backsplashes, and takes on the repair work that goes with it, like leveling floors and resurfacing ceilings. Google shows 41 reviews, all five stars, and 117 photos of finished rooms.

steps.title: Call or email Ciro
steps.text: Call (952) 356-7295 Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, or email ciros115@gmail.com with photos and the size of your bathroom.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: Ciro walks through the room with you, answers your questions and gives a clear, fair price for the work.

steps.title: Prep the room
steps.text: Plumbing, ceiling repairs and floor leveling are lined up first, and Ciro can arrange tile pickup and the plumber for you.

steps.title: Tile and finish
steps.text: The team sets the tile with care for layout and centering, keeps the workspace tidy and stays on schedule.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: You check the finished bathroom with Ciro and point out anything you want adjusted before the team packs up.

items.name: Rachel A.
items.text: We had a fantastic experience working with Ciro and his team. From the start, Ciro was very friendly, professional, and fair with pricing. He was very efficient to communicate with and I felt our bathroom was in great hands! His team was speedy and professional - Francisco did an excellent job with our tile work! We had a large block window in our shower to work around, and he centered everything perfectly. As an engineer  with a picky taste, I was so impressed with the attention to detail and speed of their work. They were right on schedule and I felt like we couldn’t have had a better team to bring our bathroom to life! Would HIGHLY recommend!

items.name: Kelly A.
items.text:
CK Tile is a great locally owned company. Ciro went above and beyond. He arranged for tile pickup, plumber, ceiling resurfacing, leveled the floor, and installed the tile. He was very patient with all my questions.
Last pics are prior to remodel.

items.name: Michael R.
items.text: Ciro and CK Tile did a fantastic job on two bathroom remodels at my home this winter. Responsive, prompt, trustworthy, and high quality, all at a fair price. I will continue to recommend them to folks in the market for their services because of the excellent work they did with us. Thank you Ciro and CK Tile!

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Minneapolis and Crystal
service_area.text: CK Tile and Home Repair LLC is based at 6530 57th Ave N in Minneapolis, and its Facebook page lists the business in Crystal. The crew remodels bathrooms and installs tile for homeowners in the area. If you live nearby and want to know whether Ciro can take your project, call (952) 356-7295 on a weekday or email photos to ciros115@gmail.com.

items.q: Do you handle plumbing and other trades?
items.a: Ciro coordinates them. On one remodel he arranged the tile pickup and the plumber, resurfaced the ceiling, leveled the floor and installed the tile. Another review mentions replacing all plumbing, wall finishes and fixtures. Ask Ciro what your bathroom needs when he visits.

items.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
items.a: Every bathroom is different, so ask Ciro for a timeline when he prices your job. Five Google reviews are tagged ahead of schedule, and one customer says the team was right on schedule from start to finish. Another had two bathrooms remodeled in one winter.

items.q: Can you work around windows in a shower?
items.a: Yes. Rachel had a large glass block window inside her shower. Tile setter Francisco centered every row around it, and she says the attention to detail impressed her as an engineer with picky taste. Send a photo of your shower so Ciro can plan the layout.

Yes. The company describes its work as tile installation from full bathrooms to kitchen backsplashes. Call (952) 356-7295 or email photos of your kitchen and the tile you have in mind, and Ciro can talk through layout, trim and timing with you.

CK Tile and Home Repair is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (952) 356-7295 during those hours, or email ciros115@gmail.com any time with photos and a short description of your project.
